question: Which plan does an EasyCron account hold when its 7-day Individual Trial ends, if it was opened by the Create Account for Free button (a POST to /user/tryit with no email address) and never added an email address and password: the Free plan, an expired plan with its cron jobs disabled, or no account at all?
why: Only the account's own pages show it, and a request for the plan page with no session is sent to the login page. First-party pages say that an expired plan's cron jobs are disabled, that an expired paid plan is downgraded to the Free plan, that the Free plan expires monthly and is renewed by a login to the plan page, and that an expired account can be deleted; the API quota page lists Individual Trial and Free as separate plans. None says what an expired Individual Trial becomes, and the plan rules of the terms page (copies of 2014, 2019 and 2022) name no trial either. One reading, unconfirmed: an expired trial is not downgraded by itself and its jobs stay disabled until the Free plan is chosen on the plan page, which fits a third-party tutorial dated 2019-05 (the plan right after registration was a trial plan, named Zen then, and the Free plan was chosen by hand with a Renew My Free Plan button). A real sign-up through the button settles it (an operator step, rq:operator): note the plan page on the first day and after the trial ends, whether the jobs still run, whether the plan page of a keyless account can still be opened, and what the account holds with and without an email address and password added. The answer decides whether identity_cost.kind of the first account is anonymous or email.
